purpose: Teach: 下地/吉村/日野/松原/三田/岩崎/山岡/稲葉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、下地氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you started a joint venture with Shimoji, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, measured pace. Quiet respect in the voice. Lean forward slightly—this is a memory being offered, not demanded. Warm acknowledgment of a shared past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは吉村先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. My father benefited greatly from Yoshimura-sensei's guidance back then.
lines.style: Clear and grounded. A pause before the name—honoring the debt. Steady eye contact. Gratitude lives in the structure of the sentence, not in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、日野氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And when you were young, you planned an overseas expansion with Hino, didn't you.
lines.style: Soft wonder. Not questioning—reflecting. The rhythm of memory. Slight trailing fade, as if watching it happen again at a distance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは松原氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. My father placed Matsubara as the cornerstone of our publicity efforts.
lines.style: Measured reflection. Trust in each word. The name lands with quiet certainty. Acknowledging a decision that held its weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、東京三田にお勤めだった
lines.en: And you worked in Tokyo, in the Mita district, when you were young.
lines.style: Gentle statement, not a question. Warm memory—seeing him there. Slight smile in the voice. The pace is unhurried, almost reverie.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは岩崎家との家族ぐるみの交流があった
lines.en: Yes. My father maintained close family relations with the Iwasaki household during those years.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. The warmth of old bonds held. Steady, respectful. A nod to connections that outlasted the office, the era.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、山岡氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And you established an overseas corporation with Yamaoka when you were young.
lines.style: Softly wondering. The memory of ambition—stated without strain. Patient pace. The voice settles on each name like a hand on a shoulder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは稲葉氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. My father entrusted all of our legal matters to Inaba.
lines.style: Closing reflection. Quiet wisdom. A man acknowledging the people who held the architecture together. Slower, more final. Deep respect woven through.
